No cross-language parallels are cataloged on SuttaCentral, and DharmaNexus identifies no matches in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, DharmaNexus identifies substantial Pali-internal text reuse, recording thirty-nine matching passages across eight Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The text shares extensive formulaic phrasing with other *hāra-sampāta* sections of the *Netti*, including the *Adhiṭṭhānahārasampāta* (Ne 33, matching segments §0.1–2.4 with §0.1–2.6), *Padaṭṭhānahārasampāta* (Ne 23), *Samāropanahārasampāta* (Ne 35), *Paññattihārasampāta* (Ne 30), *Lakkhaṇahārasampāta* (Ne 24), and *Yuttihārasampāta* (Ne 22) [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, its material is closely mirrored in exegetical literature, displaying fifteen matches with the subcommentary *Nettivibhāvinī* (especially §2.3–2.4) and seven matches with the *Nettippakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus].
